problems: The glass shows no stars, only plain blue. The starry disc sits at the back of the bore (y = 0.3), but the solid wall panels run straight across the bore at y = 0 to 0.05. That hides the disc and the stars, so the card loses its 'starry view' and the glass reads as a blank blue lens.

The bore through the hull can't be seen through the wall, so it does nothing. It is replaced by a dark space disc set just behind the glass inside the flange, with larger, more numerous flattened stars that show through the glass.
The stars (radius 0.005 to 0.01) are too small to read on a small card even when visible. Their size has been increased.
The view through the glass reads almost black, not dark blue. The space disc (#0d1640, matte) behind the tinted glass loses the brief's dark blue glass color.

The stars read as flat blue dots because the blue glass tints them. They don't read as white stars in a dark blue sky. A lighter glass tint and a bluer space disc keep the stars pale and the view dark blue.
